name: mcp-meta-hub
description: A lightweight MCP proxy that aggregates multiple MCP servers into two meta-tools: list_tools and call_tool. Stop giving your AI agent a shell — give it skills.

scripts.test: tsup src/index.ts src/e2e.test.ts src/config.test.ts src/resilience.test.ts src/features.test.ts src/http.test.ts src/lifecycle.test.ts src/oauth.test.ts --format esm --clean --sourcemap --target node20 --no-dts && (rc=0; for t in config features e2e resilience http lifecycle oauth; do node dist/$t.test.js || rc=1; done; exit $rc)

author: Luc Verdier
